name: empilha
description: Framework HTTP para Bun e TypeScript baseado em decorators e Web Standards.
author: Everton Da Silva Vieira

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts src/application/index.ts src/context/index.ts src/decorators/index.ts src/di/index.ts src/errors/index.ts src/http/index.ts src/openapi/index.ts src/schema/index.ts src/sql/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --format esm --external @sinclair/typebox --root src && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check: bun run check:code && bun run check:tests && bun run check:packages && bun run build && bun run check:package
scripts.check:packages: bun run --cwd packages/jwt check && bun run --cwd packages/pg check && bun run --cwd scaffold check
scripts.check:code: bun run typecheck && bun run format:check && bun run lint
scripts.format: oxfmt src tests scripts scaffold docs README.md package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json
scripts.test: bun test tests/compiler tests/framework tests/http tests/router tests/runtime tests/scripts tests/sql
